# Leopard-absent libSystem functions: the //sys declarations of
# golang.org/x/sys/unix v0.39.0 syscall_darwin.go that darwin/ppc32 must not
# import. Oracle: runs/jic6x-3-plan-20261022T1433Z/xsys-libc-vs-leopard.txt,
# derived from read-only `nm -g -arch ppc /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib` on the
# iBook (Mac OS X 10.5.8, libSystem 111.1.7,
# sha256 5b441f64f04e46e60ca895129795cf6bf6950222cc1823bfb819ab8bb64c2b8a,
# 4122 symbols). The Go linker binds darwin dynamic imports non-lazily at
# launch, so an import that Leopard lacks stops every program that merely
# reaches the wrapper from starting.
#
# One data row per filtered declaration, tab-separated:
# GoName<TAB>libSystem symbol<TAB>replacement. gen-host.sh drops the matching
# //sys lines from the staged syscall_darwin.go and asserts that exactly 23
# were removed.
#
# Two cases are handled but deliberately not listed here:
#   Fstatat/fstatat64 - the ppc arch file (syscall_darwin_ppc.go) does not
#     declare it, so mksyscall never emits the import; Fstatat is the AT_FDCWD
#     emulation in syscall_darwin_ppc.go.
#   fdopendir - moved out of syscall_darwin.go by commit C1
#     (syscall_darwin_libcdir.go, tagged darwin && !ppc).
readdir_r	readdir_r	dropped: plain symbol is the 32-bit-inode variant; its only caller moved to syscall_darwin_libcdir.go
utimensat	utimensat	ENOSYS (UtimesNano falls back to utimes)
renamexNp	renamex_np	ENOSYS
renameatxNp	renameatx_np	ENOSYS
pthread_chdir_np	pthread_chdir_np	ENOSYS
pthread_fchdir_np	pthread_fchdir_np	ENOSYS
connectx	connectx	ENOSYS
ClockGettime	clock_gettime	ENOSYS
Clonefile	clonefile	ENOSYS
Clonefileat	clonefileat	ENOSYS
Fclonefileat	fclonefileat	ENOSYS
Faccessat	faccessat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Fchmodat	fchmodat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Fchownat	fchownat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Linkat	linkat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Mkdirat	mkdirat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Openat	openat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Readlinkat	readlinkat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Renameat	renameat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Symlinkat	symlinkat	AT_FDCWD emulation
Unlinkat	unlinkat	AT_FDCWD emulation
preadv	preadv	ENOSYS
pwritev	pwritev	ENOSYS
